changelog: **Admin exports go through one gated route: `GET /api/admin/export/[dataset]`** (#1740, part 2; epic #1727). Exports were built entirely in the browser from data the page already held, so `REPORT_EXPORT` gated nothing. The candidates CSV/XLSX, the analytics workbook, the full analytics report workbook and the contributor-terms report now fetch their data from `/api/admin/export/{candidates,analytics,analytics-full,contributor-terms}`, which asks `entitled(orgId, 'REPORT_EXPORT')` and answers `403 { code: 'feature_locked', feature: 'REPORT_EXPORT' }` otherwise. Each dataset is the response of the endpoint the screen already reads, called in-process — tenant scoping, the `mentorship` capability and the `ADVANCED_ANALYTICS` gate on the premium sheets all stay where they are (a locked cohort/source sheet is `null`). The pages keep turning the data into the file with `src/lib/excel.ts` (SheetJS stays code-split); moving the row shapes server-side is the report registry's job (#1903). The export buttons are disabled with a note ("Exports (CSV / Excel) are part of the Program plan.", EN/TR/DE) when the org lacks the entitlement; the paged candidate list and the analytics numbers stay free to view. **Existing orgs keep their exports** (maintainer's call): `prisma/backfill-report-export-grandfather.mjs` grants every org that exists on the deploy `REPORT_EXPORT`, once — its grants carry a marker note and any later run that finds one does nothing, so orgs created after the gate do not inherit it (unit-tested). New `e2e/report-export-gate.spec.ts`; the export specs grant `REPORT_EXPORT` to the default org through `setOrgFeatureFor()`.
